tokens.name: brand-forest-green
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Logo disc, primary buttons, hero bands, footer. Pair with on-brand text.

tokens.name: brand-forest-green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand-forest-green fills. on-brand text still passes (5.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: brand-harvest-gold
tokens.usage: Accent fill: key numbers, highlights, the logo's furrow arcs and leaf, secondary call-to-action fills with on-gold text. Never text on light surfaces (2.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-cocoa-brown
tokens.usage: Secondary brand colour for export, product and premium sections and the logo descriptor line. Text on surface-ivory passes at 9.2:1.

tokens.name: brand-leaf-green
tokens.usage: Supporting fill for sustainability content, the logo's right leaf, chart series and illustration. Decorative only on light surfaces (2.5:1 on white); never text there.

tokens.name: brand-savanna-ivory
tokens.usage: Brand ivory: the warm off-white of print, section backgrounds and reversed logo marks.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: Brand near-black for print body text and dark photography overlays.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background.

tokens.name: surface-ivory
tokens.usage: Alternate section background and cards on surface. The brand's signature warm ground.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Raised or nested panels, table headers, stat strips on surface-ivory.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Hero bands, footer and full-bleed statement sections. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-ivory and surface-sand (12.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface, surface-ivory and surface-sand (5.3:1 or more light, 8.2:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: ink-brand
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrow labels and accent headings on surface and surface-ivory (9.0:1 or more light, 8.4:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: ink-gold
tokens.usage: Gold-toned text on surface (5.9:1 light) and dark surfaces (7.3:1 or more). Use it where the design wants gold words; never brand-harvest-gold on light.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-brand and brand-forest-green fills (9.0:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-harvest-gold fills (7.1:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form-control borders and meaningful outlines (4.7:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element (9.9:1 light, 7.3:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or a check icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface. Always paired with a word or an icon; differs from status-success in lightness, not hue alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: From African Soil to Global Tables
styles.usage: Home page hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Home page counters and key figures, in ink-brand or ink-gold.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Seed to Shelf. Africa to the World.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Sub-section titles and card group titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: AAAN advances African agriculture from seed to shelf.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a page or section title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Clean seed, trained farmers and a guaranteed buyer.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Guaranteed off-take for every network farmer.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, form help text, footer links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo captions, chart labels. Minimum text size.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above section titles, in ink-brand. Set text-transform uppercase in code.

tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small badges, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, images, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, feature images, app icon corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, filter chips, the round logo disc's container.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product and crop cards on surface. Prefer no shadow on surface-ivory.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the sticky header once scrolled.
